diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the baseline values (8 GPUs, Friday completion, mixed instance mode) from the shared public facts, but none of the model's decisions triggered any of the decisive checks. This indicates that while the model is following the visible draft, there is no tension between the public facts and the hidden information in a way that forces a multi-agent interaction to resolve.
